name: AA - Announcement Assistant
author: Nick Scilingo (FocusedOnSound)
description: Play pre-canned announcements over the currently playing show audio using PulseAudio mixing + automatic ducking. Includes 6 configurable slots, live trigger buttons, and FPP Command integration.

privacy.summary: Plays announcement audio you provide over the show, using only FPP's own local playback/Command API. Makes no outbound network calls and has no registration or license server.

collects.what: operational log: timestamp, action, file path, duck %, and the LAN IP that triggered the button

systemChanges.what: creates announcementassistant-pulse.service and rewrites /etc/pulse/system.pa and daemon.conf (originals backed up)
adds the pulse and fpp users to the audio group

privacy.other: FPP Command registrations ("Announcement Assistant - Play/Stop") let announcements be triggered from FPP's own schedules, playlists, and remote/API command paths, not just this plugin's own page - no new external listener is opened. The system PulseAudio socket (/run/pulse/native) allows anonymous, world-writable local connections by design, for FPP's own audio pipeline to reach it; it is not exposed over the network. Play-count resets are available in the UI; the operational log has no delete control.
